title: DoctorPat's Traps
description: A mod to add some trap items and blocks
body:
![DoctorPat's Traps](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1cd08420ebb02c1415c29f974c62272cce3ec5c1_0.webp)

## Added items and blocks

### Items

- Potion of Blindness
- Throwable Silverfish 

### Blocks

- Rotten Planks
- Infested Barrel
- Infested Chest
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#### Potion of Blindness
- 3 levels that give the blindness effect for different lengths of time depending on the level

#### Throwable Silverfish
- Silverfish the player can throw

#### Rotten Planks
- Planks that break when stepped on by a player
- Breaks some rotten planks next to it

#### Infested Barrel
- A barrel that launches silverfish in random directions when interacted with
- Breaks the bock above it if it is blocked
- Barrel breaks into silverfish if blocked by bedrock
- Activates other Infested Barrels in blocks adjacent to it

#### Infested Chest
- Chest that launches silverfish forward when interacted
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
## Crafting
### Rotten Planks
![8 planks surrounding a mushroom](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b4108ea418441aa5b9939b603232f745e52472db.jpeg)
- Can be crafted with any plank and a brown or red mushroom

### Potion of Blindness
![Ink Sac with an Awkward Potion](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d9241342eca511bc7606535c02ae392175464621.jpeg)
- Brewed with an Ink Sac and an Awkward Potion

![Glowstone Dust with Potion of Blindness](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2c705fcbbd566fd2a0d347e5874aeafbd586239a.jpeg)
- The level of the potion can be increased with glowstone dust

### Infested Chest
![Chest, silverfish item, redstone dust](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e4bb37c2fc413820572e145770c111ccb30bfb1d.jpeg)
- Crafted with a chest, silverfish item, and redstone dust
- Unshaped crafting

### Infested Barrel
![Barrel, silverfish item, redstone dust](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e221ef4bc80b108abf47e5154fb15e39b63413cf.jpeg)
- Crafted with a barrel, silverfish item, and redstone dust
- Unshaped crafting

### Silverfish
![Any infested block](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e562aacb275f4a5731224653282381a38ec60704_0.webp)
- Infested blocks can be obtained with a silk touch pickaxe
- Silverfish are crafted with any infested block
- Unshaped crafting
